title: An R-matrix evaluation's info.json
description: Everything the site shows about an evaluation that the .azr file cannot say. Checked by `npm run check:evaluations` and `python -m app.check`; explained in docs/ADDING-AN-EVALUATION.md. Only the subset of JSON Schema used here is understood by those checkers (type, required, enum, pattern, minLength, minItems, minimum, properties, additionalProperties, items, anyOf).

id.description: Optional. The directory name is the id; when given here it must be the same.

title.description: LaTeX title, e.g. ^{13}\text{N}. Derived from the model when absent.

status.description: published: in a journal (give `reference`); submitted: sent to a journal; in-progress: still being fitted; unpublished: finished, not (yet) in a paper.

reference.description: The paper's DOI, bare: 10.1103/PhysRevC.111.035802 (no https://doi.org/, no doi:).

purpose.description: One plain sentence, in English, on what the reaction does in stars: shown on the evaluation's card.

reactions.description: Unicode reaction notation, the headline reaction first: ["¹²C(p,γ)¹³N", "¹²C(p,p)¹²C"].

channels.description: LaTeX names of the particle pairs, by pair number; derived when absent.

datasets.description: A readable name for every data file the .azr reads, keyed by the file name without .dat.

atlas.description: Reaction-atlas pages that link to this evaluation, by file name: ["12C-pg-13N"]. [] for none.

split_total_capture.description: true: draw a total-capture segment as its separate transitions.
